description: Implement Testimonials (auto-scrolling glass cards), Pricing (3-tier glass cards with elevated popular tier), Contact form (two-column layout with validation and glass styling), and Footer (multi-column with newsletter signup). Final polish with prefers-reduced-motion support and commit all work.
steps: Implement src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Section heading. Auto-scrolling horizontal carousel of glass cards (infinite scroll animation using CSS or Framer Motion). Each card has: client photo (placeholder avatar), quote text, client name, and role. Cards styled with glassmorphism. Include navigation dots or swipe support for mobile.

Implement src/components/Pricing.tsx: Section heading. 3-tier pricing cards (Starter, Professional/Popular, Enterprise). Middle tier slightly elevated/scaled with accent glow border to highlight as 'Most Popular'. Each card shows: tier name, price, feature list with checkmarks, CTA button. Glass card styling with pill-shaped CTA buttons. Cards fade in with stagger on scroll.

Implement src/components/Contact.tsx: Two-column layout. Left column: heading ('Let's Work Together'), contact info (email, phone, location), social media icon links with glass hover effect. Right column: glassy form card with fields - Name (required), Email (required with validation), Phone (optional), Service Interested In (dropdown with the 6 services), Message (textarea, required). Rounded gradient 'Send Message' submit button. Form validation with inline error states (red glow on invalid fields). Success state animation on submit (just UI, no backend).

Implement src/components/Footer.tsx: Darker background than body. Multi-column layout: Column 1 - Logo + tagline. Column 2 - Quick Links (Home, Services, Work, About, Contact). Column 3 - Services list (all 6). Column 4 - Social icons (rounded glass icon buttons with hover glow) + Newsletter signup with email input and subscribe button. Bottom bar with copyright and Privacy/Terms links.
Add global smooth scroll behavior (CSS scroll-behavior: smooth on html element) in index.css
Ensure all animations respect prefers-reduced-motion media query
Run npm run build to verify everything compiles
Commit all changes to the feature/saas-landing-page branch
acceptance_criteria: Testimonials section has auto-scrolling glass card carousel
Pricing section shows 3 tiers with elevated popular tier
Contact form has all specified fields with validation UI
Footer has multi-column layout with newsletter signup
All work is committed to feature/saas-landing-page branch
verification: git log --oneline -5 to confirm commits exist
findings: All four components implemented and build verified successfully. The component files already existed as stubs from FEAT-001 so they were modified rather than created. CSS keyframes for infinite scroll animation are embedded in a style tag within Testimonials component. The prefers-reduced-motion media query is handled both via framer-motion useReducedMotion hook and via CSS media query for the scroll animation.
